column1: # Batch 31's twice-refused rows, asked three questions instead of removed.
# CLAUDE.md's rule is "re-run each FETCH_FAILED once; a row that fails twice
# leaves". Both readings are now in — 2026-10-11 (48x404, 42x403) and
# 2026-10-20 (46x404, 42x403, 2 transport) — so the condition is met for 88
# rows, and acting on it alone would have been wrong 44 times.
# Each row was asked: its own probe URL with the ENGINE's User-Agent, the same
# URL with the agent that clears the known word filter, and the HOST ROOT. The
# root is what separates "the publisher is gone" from "our path is stale".
#   44  path 404, root 200     the host is alive and serving; OUR PATH is stale.
#                              Recoverable, one re-point each. Removing these
#                              would have discarded 44 live publishers over our
#   36  path 403, root 403     the host refuses this client everywhere, and no
#                              agent in UA_OVERRIDE changes it. A wall, not a
#                              word filter and not a path problem.
#    5  path 403, root 200     refused at the endpoint while the site serves —
#                              a key, a session, or an endpoint-level wall.
#    1  path 403, alt_ua 200   OFFSHORE_AIRCRAFT_REGISTRIES. The word filter
#                              again; planelogger.com added to UA_OVERRIDE and
#                              the row recovered. Verified twice each way.
#    1  path 200               JP_EGOV_LAW_SEARCH answers 200 today for its own
#                              probe entity, so its two 404s were about the
#                              entity the audit asked with or the day it asked.
#    1  path 404, root 404     KE_OPEN_DATA — the host itself is gone. The one
#                              row the "fails twice" rule fits exactly.
#    1  timeout, root 200      CA_VESSEL_REGISTRY, unmeasured rather than dead.
# So the removal list is ONE row long, not 88. The 44 are a re-pointing job and
# the 36 are the registry.faa.gov decision this tree has already taken once:
# "the source stays honestly failing rather than quietly evading".
